name: WaveBot
author: 10G Spectrum

sections.description:
WaveBot AI Chatbot allows you to easily add an AI-powered chatbot to your WordPress website. With this plugin, you can:

  • Add your WaveBot chatbot to all pages or select specific pages
  • Customize where the chatbot appears
  • Easy setup with just your embed code
  • Maintain website performance with optimized code

External Services

This plugin connects to the WaveBot chat service (provided by 10G Spectrum) to integrate a chatbot into your WordPress site.

Data Collection and Usage

  • The plugin sends your configured chatbot ID to the WaveBot servers to load the chat widget
  • The chat widget is loaded from https://wavebot.10gspectrum.com/

Service Documentation

  • Terms of Service: https://10gspectrum.com/termsandcondition.html
  • Privacy Policy: https://10gspectrum.com/privacy-policy.html
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wavebot directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the WaveBot menu item to configure the plugin
sections.faq:
Where do I get my embed code?

You can get your embed code from your WaveBot dashboard at wavebot.10gspectrum.com

Can I choose which pages show the chatbot?

Yes, you can choose to display the chatbot on all pages or select specific pages where you want it to appear.
